title: Crisp German-Style Skillet Paneer
description: A tasty and easy German-inspired dish made with paneer, served in a crispy skillet.

ingredients.name: skillet
ingredients.notes: any type of skillet will do

instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté until softened.
Cut the paneer into small cubes and add to the skillet.
Sprinkle the salt and pepper over the paneer.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the paneer hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
